title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：uniform　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 uniform 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the teacher ① wore the uniform that no pupil in the classroom would have noted, and he said the wearing was the whole of the term. The ② uniform, meaning the outfit itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a uniform, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ uniform in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ uniform at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A uniform, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the teacher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the uniform was the whole of the matter, meaning the discipline and not the outfit. The ⑥ uniform, meaning the discipline and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; uniform, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both an outfit and a discipline. He said the discipline is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ uniform had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ uniform of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of noting; uniform, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ uniform I remember is the outfit noted in the notebook, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ uniform, my mother said in 1973, is the only outfit that improves by being noted; every uniform, she said, is a discipline that has agreed to look like an outfit. She said the discipline was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 制服（指教室里每一套旁边的那一套）
B. n. 制服（指那套制服本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the uniform 穿这一套制服
D. n. 制服（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 制服之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的制服之事）
F. n. 制服（指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一套）
G. n. 制服、规矩（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规矩（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the uniform that no pupil in the classroom would have noted

answers.why: wear the uniform 意为“穿这一套制服”，1964 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯记下的一套制服做了一遍。
uniform 意为“制服”，指那套制服本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
uniform 意为“制服”，指教室里每一套旁边的那一套，每一套旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
uniform 意为“制服”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
uniform 意为“制服、规矩”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套规矩就是那件事的全部。
uniform 意为“规矩”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套制服，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
uniform 意为“制服”，指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一套，到 1969 年这一套成了笔记簿里的一行。
uniform 意为“制服之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的制服之事是一处教室和三个学期的记下。
uniform 意为“制服”，我记得的是笔记簿里记下过的那一套，1971 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一套。
uniform 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，制服是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的制服。
